blocks.x: Reinsurance and specialty commercial books trade in complexity: treaty structures, cat exposure, bordereaux reconciliation and capital optimization. The data flows between cedants, reinsurers and brokers are still largely spreadsheets, which is why settlement cycles and model confidence suffer. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.
The ground truth of this sector

The work concentrates in bordereaux intake/reconciliation, treaty settlement, retro/capacity optimization, with specialty underwriting close behind. The paths are busy; the decisions are late. Closing that delay is worth more than any single tool purchase.
Reinsurance & Commercial Lines: where the friction concentrates,

items: Ceded premium/loss bordereaux arrive in formats and qualities; reconciliation consumes analysts and hides data quality issues.
Retro programs and cat capacity buying are combinatorial; incumbent methods stop early.
Treaty settlement disputes rest on each party's numbers; evidence chains are procedural.
Specialty risks priced on judgment with variable evidence; appetite drifts by desk.
Sensitive exposure data exchanged by email/portal; confidentiality depends on culture.
Vendor cat models integrate by file drops; portfolio views lag.
